title: Japan's GMO Warns Customers Over Ransomware Threat
excerpt: Japan's GMO Group tells customers to shut down computers and disconnect from the internet following a breach and ransomware threat.
body_html:
Japan's GMO Group has issued an urgent advisory to its customers, recommending that they disconnect their systems from the internet and shut down their computers.

This warning follows a security breach involving the company's Onamae Desktop Cloud service. According to the company, a threat actor who gained access to the platform has issued a threat to launch a ransomware attack.

Customers are advised to take immediate precautions to protect their machines and data while the situation is handled.
